essence: One should place the five beginning with Īśāna in the faces in due order.
The fifth should be placed in the side, head, face, heart, and feet.
The thirty-eight-kalā placement should be performed to increase splendor.
Each kalā mantra-word should begin with praṇava, use the kalā name ending in ṅe, and end with namaḥ.
The kalā named Aṅgadā is linked to the formula īśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānām, after which the next follows.
